title: A reviewer's findings
description: What a reviewer found that returns a delivery, one finding per entry, numbered by its place in the list. A return that numbers nothing is a question, and is refused. The commit, the verdict, the time and the reviewer are the verb's to fill, so the file carries none of them.

findings.description: The findings, in the order the seat is to read them. Never empty.

text.description: The finding: what is wrong, where, and what would make it right. Never empty.

findings.text: core/tests/schema.rs has no arm for a question naming one letter twice.
